# Appendix A – Status of Structures Assessed in the Field {-}

## Non-Actionable Barriers

```{r tbl7, echo = FALSE, results = 'asis'}
#| label: tbl7
#| tbl-cap: 'Table 7: Structures in LDN watersheds that are confirmed as barriers to fish passage for Pacific salmon as of May 2026 but have been identified by the planning team as non-actionable due to either logistic considerations (e.g., financial costs) or low-quality upstream habitat. '
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
source("Rscripts/table_formatting.R")
library("flextable")

data <- read.csv("data/LDN_non_actionable.csv", check.names=FALSE)
ft <- flextable(data)

ft <- format_flextable(ft)
ft
```

#| label: tbl8
#| tbl-cap: 'Table 8: Structures in LDN watersheds that have been assessed for fish passage for Pacific Salmon as of May 2026, but either require an additional in-depth fish-passage assessment to confirm the passability status or a habitat assessment to confirm upstream habitat values.'

ft
